text: テツが　しっかり　しないからよ！

structure.jp: テツが　しっかり　しないからよ！
structure.en: It's because you don't get your act together, Tetsu!

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because'; ending the sentence there gives the reason for what just happened. しっかり　しないからよ = 'it's because you don't shape up'.
